_note: Found-vs-oracle SLEEPING sweep: scale-free edgesPerNode=3 (mean degree ~6), UNLIMITED capacity, N=100, generous depth D=6 (so the reach cadence is not the binding constraint). Sweeps conditions.sleepingFraction — the fraction of entities that never answer (both incident links drop). The oracle always runs on the FULL, undegraded network, so routeExistsCount stays flat while the protocol loses the relays it needs. Question: how fast does P(found | a route exists) fall, and what happens to message cost, as nodes go dark? See ../README.md and packages/tallysim/docs/design.md.
